question.text: A pair of identical balls are launched straight up along the same vertical path, each with an initial speed of 40 ms⁻¹. If the second ball is released 2 s after the first, find the height above the launch point where they collide. (Take g = 10 ms⁻²)
conditions: initial speed of each ball = 40 ms⁻¹
motion along the same vertical line

solution.approach: Write the height of each ball measured from the moment each is launched, and set the two heights equal at the collision instant.

steps.text: Let t be the time measured from when the first ball is launched. Write its height.
The second ball is launched 2 s later with the same initial velocity. Write its height for t ≥ 2 s.
Set the two heights equal, since the balls collide at the same height, and solve for t.
Substitute t = 5 s into the first ball's height to get the collision height.
